info.name: Support Copilot
info.description: Requests for the current Support Copilot API. Start the backend with `uv run support-copilot` from backend/. Set base_url to match API_HOST/API_PORT. Health requires no external services. Chat requires LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_MODEL, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in backend/.env; it does not use retrieval yet. No API authentication is currently required.

request.description: Check that the API is running. Expected response: 200 with {"status": "ok"}. This does not check the database or LLM.

exec: pm.test('Service is healthy', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'ok' }); });

request.description: Send the required question field. The optional category defaults to null. Calls the configured LLM and may incur provider charges. Expected response: 200 with an answer string.

exec: pm.test('Response contains an answer string', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().answer).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Send a question with the optional category string. The current chat implementation does not use retrieval. Calls the configured LLM and may incur provider charges. Expected response: 200 with an answer string.

exec: pm.test('Response contains an answer string', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().answer).to.be.a('string'); });
